units.source_text: 斋宫今年十四岁，天生丽质，加上今日的盛妆，娇艳之相，令人吃惊。

en.t: The Saigu was fourteen this year; naturally beautiful, and made still more radiant by the splendid dress she wore that day, her loveliness was astonishing.
When Emperor Suzaku saw her, his heart was moved.

units.source_text: 临别加栉的时候，但觉深可怜惜，不禁流下泪来。

en.t: At the moment of parting, when the ceremonial comb was placed in her hair, he felt such deep tenderness and pity that he could not help shedding tears.

units.source_text: 斋宫退出的时候，八省院前正停着侍女乘坐的许多华丽的车子，在等候着。

en.t: When the Saigu withdrew, many splendid carriages for the ladies-in-waiting were standing before the Hall of State, waiting for them.

units.source_text: 帘子下面露出来的衣袖，五色缤纷，新颖触目，许多殿上人正在各自和相好的侍女惜别。

en.t: Sleeves showing beneath the blinds shimmered in many colors, fresh and striking to the eye, while many courtiers were each taking leave of the ladies-in-waiting with whom they were close.

units.source_text: 日暮时分，行列从宫中出发，前往伊势。

en.t: At dusk, the procession set out from the palace and headed for Ise.

units.source_text: 由二条大街转入洞院路时，正好在二条院门前经过。

en.t: When it turned from Nijo Avenue into Toin Road, it happened to pass directly before the gate of Nijo Palace.

units.source_text: 源氏大将正在愁闷无聊，便写了一封信，附在一枝杨桐上，送给六条妃子。

en.t: General Genji, sunk in melancholy and restlessness, wrote a letter, attached it to a branch of paulownia, and sent it to the Rokujo lady.
In the letter, he included a poem that read:
